paragraphs: My time at Nagoya University School of Medicine will be one that I cherish. During these four weeks, I learned not only about medicine, but also about a different health care system and culture. From my time here, I have met many kind and inspirational individuals. Everyone from the medical students to the professors has been extraordinarily kind and helpful. I am confident and excited to meet my new medical colleagues and friends in the future at conferences. This exchange program truly fosters the spirit of cooperation, cultural exchange, and friendship. Thank you again.
